openItems.id: Annual Plan Expensed When Paid · BVA-7, BVA-5
openItems.explanation: Tallyset Software invoice TS-44817, $16,800.00 for November 1, 2026 to October 31, 2027, was expensed in October. PRE software is $17,600.00 for October against a $800.00 budget. The chief estimator's note is right that the plan was renewed, but the whole $16,800.00 covers November 2026 to October 2027: none of it is an October cost. Under BVA-7, RC-01 moves it to 1350 Prepaid Expenses; from November it is expensed at $1,400.00 a month. Corrected, October software is $800.00, on budget, and October's net loss is $16,800.00 smaller. The reforecast carries the annual plan at $1,400.00 a month, $600.00 over the budget's $800.00.

FLD equipment repairs are $12,060.00 over budget; the note blames fuel and a heavier schedule, the ledger shows one $11,850.00 pump rebuild. October repairs are $13,660.00 against $1,600.00. The equipment manager's note says fuel and repair costs ran higher with a heavier site schedule. The ledger does not support it: fuel was $1,984.85 under budget for October; contract volume was 42.2% under budget. One line is 98% of the variance: Tamarack Equipment Service invoice 2291, excavator hydraulic pump rebuild, unit EX-04, $11,850.00. Without it, repairs were $1,810.00, $210.00 over budget. Under BVA-5 the note goes back to its owner and the commentary says what the ledger shows. Under BVA-7 the rebuild is over $5,000.00 and the invoice says it extends the unit's life by about three years, so it is raised with the Controller as a possible capital item; no entry is proposed until the Controller decides.

openItems.id: Unsigned Award in the Reforecast · BVA-6
openItems.explanation: Alder Crossing Medical Office Tenant Improvement, $640,000.00, is in the submitted reforecast without a signed contract. The business development manager's reforecast carries Alder Crossing Medical Office Tenant Improvement for Alder Crossing Medical Group LLC at $640,000.00 of revenue from January to May, status “Verbal award; contract not signed”. BVA-6 admits new work only under a signed contract, so this reforecast leaves it out and shows it as upside: $640,000.00 of revenue and $73,600.00 of gross profit at its 11.5% estimated margin. With it, full-year revenue would be $3,105,050.23 instead of $2,465,050.23. Halvorsen Dental Lab Fit-Out ($412,000.00), signed October 28, 2026, is in. If the contract is signed before the board meets, the CFO can move it into the reforecast.

openItems.id: Revenue Held on an Unrevised Estimate · BVA-5, BVA-6
openItems.explanation: Ridgecrest Veterinary Exam Room Expansion (S-2607) earned nothing in October against $38,000.00 budgeted; its estimate was last revised September 22, 2026. The approved WIP schedule holds S-2607's earned revenue at September's level because its project manager did not revise the estimate to complete for October, while $21,350.00 of October cost went in. So October shows a $21,350.00 gross loss on the job, and its $38,000.00 revenue shortfall is timing, not lost work, until the estimate is revised. The reforecast uses the same unrevised estimate: $81,397.89 of backlog at a $72,000.00 cost to complete, $9,397.89 of gross profit for the rest of the year. The CFO should not sign the job's numbers as final until the project manager dates a new estimate (WIP-4).
The one-page board pack and the commentary are drafts. The CFO reviews, changes if needed and signs before release.
